interventions.detail: Installed CPU-only torch wheel from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu (README assumes CUDA GPU)
Used uv venv with Python 3.10 instead of conda
Pinned resolved versions (torch 2.14.1, pytorch-lightning 2.6.6, vector-quantize-pytorch 1.34.0, transformers 5.20.2) for reproducibility
Cloned with GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 since synthetic training needs no LFS assets
